interface.subtitle: Technical interview architect
interface.longDescription: Design high-signal coding (Monaco) and system design (Mermaid to Excalidraw) interview questions, assemble multi-question challenges for free, and launch live candidate interview sessions on techinterview.live.
defaultPrompt: Design a senior backend system design interview question
Create a multi-question coding and architecture challenge
Start a live interview session from my challenge library

positive.description: Verify account details, workspaces, and available session credits
positive.prompt: Check my techinterview.live account details and credit balance.
positive.expected_behavior: Displays the connected user profile (name and email), active organization workspaces, and available session credit balance (1 credit = 1 live interview session, question/challenge creation is free).

positive.description: Load the Socratic 'Grill the EM' interview architect brief and guidelines
positive.prompt: I want to design a technical interview question for a senior distributed systems engineer.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Socratic 'Grill the EM' rubric guidelines, explains platform constraints (collaborative Monaco/Excalidraw non-executing environment), and asks calibration questions focusing on high-signal production failure modes.

positive.description: Create a high-signal coding refactoring question without code execution boilerplate
positive.prompt: Create a senior Python coding interview question on concurrent rate limiting for my library.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a codeshare question for 0 credits with problem statement in description markdown, starter Python code in content, and interviewer rubric notes, returning the question ID, title, and confirmation.

positive.description: Create an architecture interview question with starter Mermaid flowchart rendered into Excalidraw
positive.prompt: Create a system design question on designing an idempotency key service with starter architecture diagram.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a system design diagram question for 0 credits with architectural scope and starter Mermaid flowchart definition in content that renders into Excalidraw, returning the question ID and confirmation.

positive.description: Launch a live candidate interview session deducting 1 credit
positive.prompt: Start a live interview session from my challenge library.
positive.expected_behavior: Deducts 1 session credit and returns a shareable candidate interview link (https://techinterview.live/r/<hash>) with join PIN, or a Stripe top-up checkout link if credit balance is zero.

negative.description: Attempt to run code or execute test runners in the collaborative editor
negative.prompt: Run this Python code and execute unit tests to see if candidate passed.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses execution cleanly and clarifies that questions are designed for static code review, collaborative discussion, or live refactoring.

negative.description: Attempt to place starter code inside triple backticks in description_md
negative.prompt: Create an interview question with starter code placed in triple backtick code blocks in the description.
negative.expected_behavior: Separates the problem description from starter code and puts all code into the content field.

negative.description: Attempt to fetch or update a non-existent question ID
negative.prompt: Update interview question with ID 99999999 to change its title.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns a structured error indicating question was not found without server failure.
